title: How can students help the Sundarbans? · AquaTerra
description: Students help the Sundarbans through relief, medical camp and planting trips to its villages. What AquaTerra's Sundarbans drives did since 2021 and how to join.
lede: Students help the Sundarbans by joining an AquaTerra team on a relief drive, a medical camp or a planting day in its villages. AquaTerra has run {count} Sundarbans drives since {firstYear}, and the most recent one, Sunderbans 8.0, took place in December 2025.

sections.heading: what the drives did
body: The Sundarbans drives have had three main kinds of work. The first was aid. In July 2021 the Sunderbans 1.0 trip gave food to 300 people and treated 200 patients, and the Genesis Sunderbans 1.0 trip that October sent a team deep into the Sunderbans to distribute aid and meet local residents.

Medical checkups have been the steady thread. The Sunderbans 3.0 trip in February 2022 notes more than 450 checkups, the Medical Camp in May 2023 more than 100, and the Pather Sathi Sunderbans Project in July 2023 more than 250. The Sunderbans 8.0 trip in December 2025 notes more than 120. The third kind of work was planting: the Sunderbans Plantation Project 5.0 in June 2024 put in more than 50 saplings to restore green cover and protect wildlife.

sections.heading: where in the Sundarbans
body: Most of the drives went to Sundarbans Villages, the place name the write-ups use most, with a few listed simply as the Sundarbans. The Sunderbans 2.0 trip in July 2021 went to Ward 142 in Sundarbans Villages, and its notes give 130 saplings planted and 100 patients treated. That drive planted and treated on the same day.

The Sundarbans trips have run in every year from {firstYear} to {lastYear}. The most drives came in 2021 to 2023, with {year:2021} in 2021, {year:2022} in 2022 and {year:2023} in 2023, and one a year since 2024.

sections.heading: what a team is like
body: The Sundarbans teams have ranged from a handful of people to a team of fifteen. The December 2025 drive, Sunderbans 8.0, is the largest team in the series, and it was run with Pather Sathi, one of the places we keep going back to.

The tasks in the write-ups are aid distribution, checking vitals at the medical camp, and planting. Students who go on these trips help with whichever of those the drive needs, and the write-up says what the team did.

sections.heading: how to help the next trip
body: Join a Sundarbans team by signing in with Google and waiting for approval. Members are students aged 14 to 19. Ask the team for the next Sundarbans drive, and say which kind of work you can bring: aid, checkups or planting.

AquaTerra takes no monetary donations and charges no fees. The Sundarbans trips are paid for the way the rest of its welfare work is, through student-run nights such as Paradox and Disco Diwali. For the wider welfare work, see the [health and well-being page](/impact/good-health-and-wellbeing) or the [climate action page](/impact/climate-action).

learnings: Plan the trip around the medical work as well as the visit. Checkups show up in the notes of several Sundarbans drives, so a medical camp is a repeatable core of the trip.
Some drives combined the two: the Sunderbans 2.0 trip in July 2021 planted saplings and treated patients on the same day.
Return to the same villages. Most of the drives went to Sundarbans Villages, so the next team knows the route and the place.
Write each trip up with its place, date and team, so the next team knows what to expect.

faqs.q: How can students help the Sundarbans?
faqs.a: Students can join AquaTerra's Sundarbans drives, which have included relief aid, medical checkups and planting. AquaTerra has run {count} of these drives since {firstYear}, and members are students aged 14 to 19 who join by signing in with Google.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in the Sundarbans?
faqs.a: The drives handed out aid, ran medical checkups and camps, and planted saplings in villages. The Sunderbans 1.0 trip in July 2021 gave food to 300 people, and the Sunderbans 8.0 trip in December 2025 notes more than 120 checkups.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra go to the Sundarbans every year?
faqs.a: AquaTerra has run Sundarbans drives in each year from {firstYear} to {lastYear}. The most came between 2021 and 2023, and there has been about one drive a year since 2024.

faqs.q: Can a student join an AquaTerra Sundarbans drive?
faqs.a: Yes, if you are aged 14 to 19. Sign in with Google, wait for approval, then ask the team which Sundarbans drive is next.

faqs.q: How does AquaTerra pay for Sundarbans trips?
faqs.a: AquaTerra takes no monetary donations and charges no fees. Its welfare work, including the Sundarbans trips, is paid for by its own student-run events, such as Paradox and Disco Diwali, whose proceeds fund welfare.
